### Join SHPE National

Choosing to become a SHPE member means becoming part of a greater mission, supporting and uplifting a community, honoring the promises made before us, and helping turn dreams into reality.

We are familia. SHPE is a welcoming and inclusive community where everyone is valued and accepted. It’s a place where you never have to question whether you belong, because you are already part of something special. No matter where you come from, there is a place for you here. Welcome home.

[Become a Member](https://shpe.org/membership/become-a-member/){.btn .join-btn target="_blank"}

::: {.join-fee}
